newsitem.title: USA: St. Louis puzzles over object from the sky.
newsitem.headline: St. Louis puzzles over object from the sky.

text.p: A metal object fell from the sky onto a downtown St. Louis street Thursday, leaving police puzzled as to whether it came off a plane.
"We don't know what it is. We've called in aviation people to look at it," a St. Louis police department spokesman said.
Serial numbers were written on the metallic piece, which was described as "pretty sizeable," leading police to suspect it could might have come off an airplane.
